notes.title: Community Update #2 | 7/18/25
notes.content:
[p]Hey Splitfam, welcome to our first Community Update where each week we’ll be recapping news you may have missed, highlighting your creations, and letting you know about upcoming community events. Let’s get right to it.[/p][p][/p][hr][/hr][h2][b]What’s New?[/b][/h2][previewyoutube="QkLcOfOM7vw;full"][/previewyoutube][p]In our third Splitgate Weekly video, our Lead Game Designer Darek shared a preview of some upcoming balance changes as well as some perspective on his approach to balance in Splitgate 2. Make sure to share your own takes on game balance in the comments after hearing from him. Our team is still heads-down on a long list of fixes and improvements which you’ll be hearing more about soon.[/p][p]
We’re also continuing our regular player surveys and would greatly appreciate you taking the time to complete [url="https://survey.alchemer.com/s3/8389991/SG2-Weekly-Survey-7-14-25"][u]this week’s SG2 survey.[/u][/url][b] [/b]It won’t take long, we promise.[/p][p][/p][hr][/hr][h2][b]Community Map Highlights[/b][/h2][p]
[img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45110560/97cc549e77e97be73dd52235bcfc0be2a809e5b8.jpg"][/img][/p][h3][b]Club Silo [/b]by Ahayayeeti[/h3][p][b]Code:[/b] mmv-jrr-nz2[/p][p]Get ready to show off your moves in this incredible remake of Club Silo from Splitgate 1. The portal party never stops over here![/p][p]
[img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45110560/45b2bad1eaf18aa5da2423f2cb248fadc999622b.jpg"][/img][/p][h3][b]Urban Flora [/b]by Je11y_thebro[/h3][p][b]Code: [/b]wk0-2qg-y3t
[/p][p]This space-themed urban garden from Je11y has clearly been tended with care. Don’t let the beautiful architecture and greenery fool you though, this is a chaotic battlefield that will put your portalling to the test.
[/p][h3][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45110560/e30387780db30a794bcbf170e2d204e2f8ca1106.png"][/img][/h3][h3][b]Surf Slide [/b]by DubbleA302 [/h3][p][b]Code:[/b] in3-gwv-vmx
[/p][p]We mentioned recently that ice is now appropriately slippery across custom maps from the Lab, and DoubleA302 wasted no time taking advantage of that. Movement fans should definitely check this one out, just make sure to bundle up first.[/p][p]
[img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45110560/90efc6f5d6ef982d2d91e36f7f1843ff5142f501.jpg"][/img][/p][h3][b]Whack-A-Mole [/b]by Jangutu [/h3][p][b]Code:[/b] sd5-rpj-uai
[/p][p]Looking to play something truly outside of the box? Jangutu has you covered and the setup is simple: grab a Deadbolt and tell your friends to start jumping. This is surely the pinnacle of aim training, no question.[/p][p]
Are you a certified Lab Rat with a creation worth showing off? [url="https://forms.gle/W7dfJWXGKAC3PbMD9"][u]Tell us about it through this form[/u][/url] so we can take a look for future weeks![/p][p][/p][hr][/hr][h2][b]MVP Spotlight[/b][/h2][p]
[img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45110560/2eeae6f871d1ee167cfc95573ad13ec38578907b.jpg"][/img][/p][p]This week we’re spotlighting our MVP [b]OmnicientWolf [/b]and asked him a few questions about him and his content!
[/p][p][b]Q: How did you first get into Splitgate?[/b][/p][p][i]I first got into Splitgate during the peak period where you had to often wait 3 hours in a login queue to get in due to the influx of players wanting to get in!  As a Halo fan, the idea of “Halo with portals” attracted me, and then once I started getting the hang of the portals, I was hooked!
[/i][/p][p][b]Q: How would you describe the content you make?[/b][/p][p][i]I mostly stream and create content around Splitgate 2 gameplay, whether that be messing around in socials or getting sweaty in ranked.  That being said, I also dabble in educational content, especially if I have a question that I’m trying to get to the bottom of myself!  I’m a strong believer in sharing your knowledge with people, so if that’s something that I can do, then hey, sign me up.
[/i][/p][p][b]Q: What modes do you play most often?[/b][/p][p][i]I’m definitely a 4v4 guy first and foremost.  I enjoy both social and ranked arena modes, so it really depends on what I’m feeling and who’s playing with me at the time.  In terms of specific playlist modes, I’ve always been a Team Deathmatch kind of guy, although I do enjoy Hot Zone quite a bit!
[/i][/p][p][b]Q: Where can people find you to check out your content?[/b][/p][p][i]My most active platforms are [url="https://www.twitch.tv/OmnicientWolf"][u]Twitch[/u][/url] and [url="https://x.com/OmnicientWolf"][u]Twitter[/u][/url] (or X, if you will).

Currently, I stream 3 days a week, Tuesdays – Wednesdays – Thursdays starting at 9 PM ET.[/i]
[/p][p][b]Q: Is there any content you’ve made that you’d like to highlight?[/b][/p][previewyoutube="kx5sKIg6SLw;full"][/previewyoutube][p][i]One of my first videos on Splitgate 2 was “3 Beginner Tips in 3 Minutes for Splitgate 2”[/i][/p][p]
[url="https://x.com/Splitgate/status/1943009005368152498"]https://x.com/Splitgate/status/1943009005368152498[/url][/p][p][i]One of my funnier posts is when the 1/200 chance to fart in-game had me chuckling, as featured on the Splitgate 2 socials.
[/i]
[url="https://x.com/OmnicientWolf/status/1942644859485184281"]https://x.com/OmnicientWolf/status/1942644859485184281[/url][/p][p][i]And another one is showing off the ability to shoot the splitball in Splitgate 2[/i][/p][p]
[b]Q: Anything else you'd like to say to the community?[/b][/p][p][i]I don’t think Arena Shooters get enough love in today’s day and age, so I do hope that the community can rally together and help shape Splitgate 2 to be the best that it can be.[/i][/p][p][/p][hr][/hr][h2][b]Community Events
[/b][/h2][h3][b]Space Man In-Game Event [/b](7/18-7/28)[/h3][list][*][p][i]Check out the new [b]Rapid Royale Zero G [/b]mode featuring Battle Royale combat with low gravity, Mythic weapons skins, and more! Unlock exclusive rewards by playing any game mode until the event ends.[/i][/p][/*][/list][h3][b]Play Together [/b](7/18)[/h3][list][*][p][i]Interested in playing some Takedown with devs instead of hunting them down? Head over to [url="https://discord.com/invite/splitgate"][u]our Discord server[/u][/url] between 1:00 - 5:00 PM PT today to compete for your chance to win Splitcoin prizes.
[/i][/p][/*][/list][p]GLHF and we'll see you back next week![/p]

notes.title: Community Update #1 | 7/11/25
notes.content:
[p]Hey Splitfam, welcome to our first Community Update where each week we’ll be recapping news you may have missed, highlighting your creations, and letting you know about upcoming community events. Let’s get right to it.[/p][p][/p][hr][/hr][h2][b]What’s New?[/b][/h2][p]Our Season 1 Chapter 2 update arrived with Ranked, Mastery Challenges, improvements to the Lab, and more. [url="https://www.splitgate.com/news/ranked-weapons-mastery-skins-have-arrived"]Check out the patch notes here if you missed them.[/url][/p][p][/p][previewyoutube="jsCnarFF-bo;full"][/previewyoutube][p]In our second Splitgate Weekly video, our co-founders Ian and Nick shared more information about what we’re working on and the team’s priorities for fixing the game.[/p][p]
We’re doing more to quantify your feelings on the game and make sure we’re moving in the right direction. If you haven’t done so already, consider filling out [url="https://survey.alchemer.com/s3/8380306/SG2-Weekly-Survey-7-4-25"]this week’s SG2 survey.[/url][/p][p][/p][hr][/hr][h2][b]Community Maps Spotlight
[/b][/h2][p][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45110560/d3cbd1466ba166f914a7db1568719ef2edb28723.jpg"][/img][/p][h3][b]Celerity [/b]by Code Phoenix[/h3][p][b]Code:[/b] my5-yne-imc
[/p][p]With creative launch pad positioning and great portal placement, Celerity is an absolute blast to fly through at top speeds. Takedown fans should definitely add this one to their rotation.[/p][p]
[img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45110560/0215250507451ef97fccdc6914bd6b3f966c3bc7.jpg"][/img][/p][h3][b]Atlantis SG1 Remake [/b]by ahayayeetu[/h3][p][b]Code: [/b]op3-ogs-aqr
[/p][p]Feeling nostalgic for some undersea action? Dive into this awesome remake of an SG1 classic. 
[/p][h3][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45110560/f037573f96588865f05516998461c677e8641abc.jpg"][/img][b]Don’t Fall / Only Up / Parkour [/b]by TTV:DjTyrannosaurusflex [/h3][p][b]Code:[/b] t0o-2fj-3ig
[/p][p]If you think you’ve mastered movement in Splitgate 2, it might be time to put your skills to the test in this wild parkour map. Be warned: you might end up testing your endurance more than anything else.[/p][p]
[img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45110560/19c9ac9b633bc7f46ffea33c8e74e0c38b7be69b.jpg"][/img][/p][h3][b]Krusty Krab [/b]by AceBoogieJP[/h3][p][b]Code:[/b] 91g-u2y-tep
[/p][p]If you’ve ever wanted to live out your fry cook fantasies, we may have found the secret formula you’ve been looking for. Big Head Snipers on this map is a personal favorite over here.[/p][p]
[img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45110560/899d5aa372967e1733b7a7a06f3e810f89dbf8e1.jpg"][/img][/p][p]Interested in making your own unique maps in the Lab? There’s never been a better time with the recent introduction of Mirroring options, circular portal walls, the new Sandbox building set, the new Glacier biome set, and much more! 

Once your custom creation is ready to play, [url="https://forms.gle/W7dfJWXGKAC3PbMD9"]tell us about it through this form[/url] and you might see it featured in a future Community Update.[/p][p][/p][hr][/hr][h2][b]Splitgate MVP Highlights[/b][/h2][p]
Our Splitgate MVPs are always creating great content and this week was no exception.[/p][previewyoutube="d9Lb1YiGjAI;full"][/previewyoutube][previewyoutube="WvRha8Toyn8;full"][/previewyoutube][p]Need some help getting your loadouts in order before starting the Ranked grind? Mikaveli and MayorReynoldsTV have you covered.
[/p][previewyoutube="8lM4n9qlQ9E;full"][/previewyoutube][p]Already have your gear in order and just want to watch some great Ranked matches instead? Check out Staycation’s latest video for a preview of what to expect.[/p][p][/p][hr][/hr][h2][b]Community Events[/b][/h2][p][b]4th of July [/b](7/4 - 7/18)[/p][list][*][p]The fireworks are still flying! You can unlock unique in-game rewards for free through next Friday by playing any mode or taking out enemies with the FUBAR power weapon.[/p][/*][/list][p][b]Hunt The Devs [/b](7/11)[/p][list][*][p]Keep an eye out for aces with disco ball heads in Arena Quick Play! Our devs are going to be queueing up between 1:00 - 5:00 PM PT today, and killing them will earn you one of three exclusive Dev Killer skins.[/p][/*][/list][p][b]Play Together [/b](7/18)[/p][list][*][p]Interested in playing with devs instead of hunting them down? Head over to [url="https://discord.com/invite/splitgate"]our Discord server[/url] between 1:00 - 5:00 PM PT next Friday to compete for your chance to win Splitcoin prizes. We’ll be playing our next featured game mode together and we promise it’s out of this world.[/p][/*][/list][hr][/hr][p]As always, thank you for playing and for sharing your feedback with our team. We’ll be back with another hotfix next week and will have a lot more to share with you all very soon.[/p][p]GLHF this weekend![/p]

notes.title: WELCOME TO SPLITGATE: BATTLE ROYALE!
notes.content:
Hey, Splitfam, we told you that we still had another ace up our sleeve and we are so excited that we finally get to share it with you:

[h2]Splitgate: Battle Royale![/h2]

That’s right, in addition to our core Arena modes like Hotzone and Firecracker, our 24-Player Onslaught modes like Domination, and The Lab (our map creator), [i]Splitgate 2[/i] has a [b]Battle Royale[/b]!
[previewyoutube=fbSy_htoqHU;full][/previewyoutube]

[h2]HERE’S WHAT YOU NEED TO KNOW:[/h2]
[list]
[*] 15 teams of 4 drop in and battle it out to be the last team standing 
[*] At the start, you and your team decide when to drop from an airship flying above [b]Split Worlds[/b], a gigantic map comprised of 5 unique biomes connected by huge World Portals
[*] You start with just a pistol and collect powerful loot from Chests, Air Drops, and Player Pods that get left behind after you take down an enemy player
[*] Collect Credits and spend them at Buy Stations for Power Weapons, Upgrades, and more
[*] Find Armor Plates and Armor Upgrades to stay in the fight longer
[*] Pick up Portal Gun Upgrades to use your portals to their full potential
[*] Chests refill with better loot each round, so be sure to keep checking them
[*] The Ring gradually forces teams together, closing Worlds from play and dealing damage to players who get caught in its path
[*] If you are killed you can be revived by teammates, and you also have a chance to respawn–but only if your team stays alive
[*] Lastly, watch out for Events that temporarily change gameplay, like the Portal EMP Event, which disables portals, or the Drop Frenzy Event, which increases Air Drop frequency
[/list]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45110560/68ba90789175f12a3ce82f99e357278d54719688.jpg[/img]

[h2]A FEW MORE TIPS:[/h2]
[list]
[*] At the beginning of the match when you drop from the ship, you will travel the direction you’re looking. 
[*] As the match progresses, World Portals will close if they lead to a biome that is outside of The Ring.
[*] Remember to use your armor! We’ve found that players familiar with the Arena modes of Splitgate 2 sometimes don’t realize you need to press a button to armor up after you take damage (you start with full armor)
[*] After you’re killed, if you have teammates who are still alive, a countdown will appear for when you’ll respawn back into the action. You’ll respawn near the teammate you’re spectating (and will be blocked from respawning if the ally you are spectating is in combat)
[/list]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45110560/6ea8b92c52fdfdf0c481f7481f0d758201119d28.jpg[/img]

[h2]SOME USEFUL KEY BINDS:[/h2] 
[list]
[*] Macro Map: Tap M
[*] Scoreboard and Inventory: Hold Tab
[*] Apply Armor: Tap 4 to use your Armor Plates
[*] Player Pods: Hold F to Revive a teammate; Tap F to loot an enemy or to pick up and carry a teammate’s Player Pod
[/list]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45110560/98fd47bfc413a1646b1f4a5be0c0e50366a63efb.jpg[/img]

[h2]THE FIVE BIOMES OF SPLIT WORLDS[/h2]
[list]
[*] [b]Drought[/b] – the desert biome
[*] [b]Fracture[/b] – the floating asteroids biome 
[*] [b]Glacier[/b] – the snow biome
[*] [b]Inferno[/b] – the volcano biome
[*] [b]Sanctum[/b] – the central ruins
[list][*]Sanctum is filled with special loot and connected to all the other worlds. In our lore, only the Sanctum is on Earth. The other worlds are spread across the galaxy, each connected by giant World Portals at the Sanctum, the hub of Split Worlds. Pockets of geothermal activity, mysterious gravitational patterns, and other emerging anomalies all seem to be connected to the presence of proelium, the mysterious substance that makes portal travel possible.[/list][/list]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45110560/0dfe5c95dbd47d7cb47b9145156844efd34b849a.jpg[/img]

notes.title: Play the Splitgate 2 Open Beta Free beginning on May 22
notes.content:
The Open Beta starts on May 22nd, and will stay live through the launch of the full game this summer. The Open Beta has way more than our last Alpha this past February, and it still doesn’t have everything that will be in the full version of the game at launch (Splitfam, keep that quiet–all shall be revealed soon). For now, we want to tell you about some of the exciting new features in the Open Beta.


[h2]INTRODUCING THE LAB, OUR NEW MAP CREATOR[/h2]
[list]
[*][b]The Lab[/b] is what we’re calling our brand new creative mode, where you can create your very own maps and game modes.
[*]Our goal with The Lab is simple: we want anyone to be able to jump in (alone or with friends) and build something awesome—no experience required. At the same time, we’ve built in the depth and flexibility for power users to bring even their wildest ideas to life.
[*]We took inspiration from [i]Unreal Engine[/i] and [i]Halo’s Forge[/i], and how fun and possible it was to make something really cool with your friends. In fact, [i]Halo Reach[/i] was a big reason our CEO and many of our level designers originally got into game development! We hope to bring that level of creativity to a new generation of gamers.
[*]In The Lab, you’ll be able to collaborate in real time on maps with your friends (up to 16 players at a time), and you’ll of course be able to share your maps with the world. 
[*]The Lab has a variety of blank canvas templates for you to begin building your maps, as well as scalable geometric shapes, prefabricated SSL map items, environmental props, and other gameplay objects to bring your vision to life.
[*]And just like we hope you start working in The Lab, we’re going to keep working on it, too. We've been building The Lab with the community and for the community. We have lots of content coming to the map creator system post launch. We’re planning to continue to support it and add to it for years to come based on community feedback and requests. 
[*]So, go check out The Lab and let us know what you think. We’re going to feature the coolest, most fun, and most creative maps that the community creates, so don’t hold back. We can’t wait to see what you create.
[*]And for the real map making fiends out there, you can [url=https://mvp.splitgate.com/]apply to be a Splitgate MVP[/url]. We have a map creator category! 
[*]Want to see a glimpse of what’s possible? Take a look at Eclipse, an incredible community-made map by [url=https://x.com/UneeQtV]UneeQ[/url].
[/list]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45110560/57052a3287e518dc8fc3828a9a686b0fd6c50dc0.jpg[/img]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45110560/1f9952dda6a6076dce5d2acc91f976636af088d6.jpg[/img]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45110560/012fdad53b0c5d01310a58b425437cd75f0353bd.jpg[/img]

[previewyoutube=BBiSnzHaoxk;full][/previewyoutube]

[i](Full disclosure: The Lab’s functionality is still in Beta, so maps created during Beta could be impacted by changes to the mode later on. We currently don’t anticipate that any major issues will arise, but we want to flag this as a possibility as we continue to update and improve the map creator system.)[/i]


[h2]TAKEDOWN AND FOUR NEW SIMULATION MAPS[/h2]
[list]
[*] [b]Takedown[/b] is back! OG Splitgate players loved playing Takedown on our Simulation maps. We’re thrilled to announce that we’re bringing back the Takedown game mode. 
[*] For the uninitiated, Takedown is a fan-favorite mode from the original Splitgate with a simple mechanic: teams compete to wipe out the other team before any players can respawn back into the game. But there’s a catch: killing makes your team’s respawns shorter, and dying makes your team’s respawns longer. So, the first team to have all enemy players dead at the same time wins the round.
[*] That means in the Open Beta you’ll be able to play Takedown on not one, not two, not three, but four brand new Simulation maps. 
[*] One of those new maps is an updated version of [b]Simulation Charlie[/b], one of our most popular maps in the original [i]Splitgate[/i]
[*] We’ve honored the original simplistic style of the Simulation maps with an updated gloss that makes them better than ever.
[*] And we’re not stopping at four. We’re going to keep adding more Simulation maps in upcoming seasons. 
[*] Plus, the map creator features in The Lab include the tools necessary for players to create their own Simulation maps, so the possibilities for more maps are endless.
[/list]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45110560/45b846d935b5af8458c95902533de02c883fddb8.jpg[/img]

[h2]NEW ARENA MAPS: CORE AND (THE TRIUMPHANT RETURN OF) STADIUM[/h2]
[list]
[*] We’re adding two new arena maps: Core and Stadium. Now along with Bypass, Eden, Frontier, Ozone, and Zenith, you’ll be able to play our arena modes on seven different maps. 
[*] [b]Core[/b]: This map takes you underneath the surface of Venus to a mysterious Meridian research laboratory and cybernetic intelligence server. Built around a floating spherical artifact, this map is action packed, with verticality in the center and ramps trailing outward so you can grab some momentum before a quick portal behind your opponent in the OmNom food court area.
[list][*] Note: Core will be coming later in the Open Beta period, shortly after May 22nd.[/list]
[*] [b]Stadium[/b]: Takedown isn’t the only thing back from the first Splitgate in this Open Beta! Ever since we announced we were working on Splitgate 2, we’ve had people in the community asking if we were going to bring back Stadium, the most popular map from the first game. With the Open Beta, we’re stoked to reveal that Stadium is indeed oh so back. 
[*] Fans of the original Stadium will recognize the layout, but also notice some key changes we’ve made to make gameplay even better, including a launchpad for mid-air combat in the map’s center, a death pit in the basement for any portal pranksters who want to go for a sneaky portal kill, and overall improved navigation and portal opportunities.
[/list]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45110560/539e946b68d1f541e95ff0cb6b0008b03a1fe0d7.jpg[/img]

[h2]NEW 24-PLAYER ONSLAUGHT MAPS: DROUGHT AND FRACTURE[/h2]
[list]
[*] Joining [b]Glacier[/b], our massive multi-team map from the Open Alpha, we’re adding two new giant maps: [b]Drought[/b] and [b]Fracture[/b]. 
[*] [b]Drought[/b]: “Drought” is the nickname given to the portion of the desert moon Verdantis, recently discovered and now used as a part of the Splitgate competition. A mostly barren moon that was once full of life, this desert biome is actually a dried out seabed. The cliff walls are infused with proelium dust, but don’t get distracted by the sparkles as you navigate these treacherous canyons.
[*] [b]Fracture[/b]: The floating islands of Fracture are the result of an extremely unique gravitational pattern combined with competing magnetic forces in the soil, likely caused by a chain reaction from a proelium-infused geothermal explosion. This Splitgate map is in the Epsilon Eridani star, and is without question our most out-of-this-world map yet. Enjoy the launch pads connecting the floating islands, but watch your step and mind the gap: it’s a long drop down. 
[*] Note: we’re now calling the multi-team modes that happen on these massive maps our [b]“Onslaught”[/b] modes. We had previously called them “Multi-Team Portal Warfare” in the last Alpha.
[/list]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45110560/4a9b77070f94f645000f1c48951d4e129cce179f.jpg[/img]

[h2]NEW POWER WEAPON: BOREALIS[/h2]
[list]
[*] For the first time, in the Open Beta you’ll get to play with the Borealis, a new power weapon from the Meridian faction. 
[*] The Borealis is a charge-up power carbine. Think of it like a combination of a railgun and an energy beam rifle. 
[*] It’s named after the natural electrical phenomenon characterized by streams of color lighting up the sky–fire it once and you’ll see why.
[*] To see the Borealis in action, check out [url=https://www.tiktok.com/@splitgate/video/7489553972198477098?is_from_webapp=1&sender_device=pc&web_id=7497371895093347886]this video[/url].
[/list]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45110560/5a2da8053a9112a88825e6775752119e90307688.gif[/img]

[h2]BETA BATTLE PASS[/h2]
[list]
[*] The Open Beta will have our first mini Battle Pass. It includes: 
[list]
[*] Three exclusive character skins
[*] Three exclusive weapon skins
[*] One exclusive portal skin
[*] Multiple emotes, sprays, weapon charms, and player card banners and titles
[*] Plus bonus Splitcoin and Proelium (our cosmetic upgrade currency)
[/list]
[*] It will cost 500 Splitcoin (roughly $4.99 USD). 
[*] The Beta Battle Pass is the first taste of how we’ll be handling Battle Passes at launch and beyond. Instead of one long Battle Pass for the three months of a season, we’ll have three shorter and lower-priced Battle Passes corresponding to monthly narrative chapters. More info on our mini Battle Pass system can be found on our blog [url=https://www.splitgate.com/news/beta-battle-pass-founder-s-packs-and-more]here[/url]. 
[/list]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45110560/507564c6459b412a1146961ac3da1f73b65c65de.jpg[/img]

[h2]FOUNDER’S PACKS[/h2]
[list]
[*] There are three faction themed Founder’s Packs, each with: 
[list]
[*] Two exclusive character skins
[*] Three exclusive weapon skins
[*] Plus a bonus emote, weapon charm, and player card banner
[/list]
[*] Gotta have them all? The Aces Founder’s Bundle includes the cosmetic items of all three Faction Founder's Packs, plus 2000 Splitcoin ($20 value) and the exclusive Chef’s Kiss emote.
[*] Want even more? The Ultimate Founder’s Bundle has all the cosmetic items above, plus nine additional Primary Weapon skins, six additional Secondary Weapon skins, and 3000 Splitcoin ($30 value).
[/list]

[h2]INTRODUCING: MYTHIC UPGRADES AND COSMETIC VARIANTS[/h2]
[list]
[*] We’re remaining dedicated to our promise to never have any items that have game perks or pay-to-win features. 
[*] Our upcoming cosmetic options will be introducing some exciting ways to flex your style, such as [b]Mythic[/b] level rarity character skins and weapon skins that come with unique reload animations (that are cosmetic only and don’t actually impact gameplay at all). 
[*] Our plan is to have rotations of Legendary and Mythic items in the store every couple weeks.
[*] We’ll also have skin [b]variants[/b] and [b]upgrades[/b] that you can get by using [b]Proelium[/b], our new upgrade currency. These will be cosmetic only and will not affect gameplay. 
[*] You can get Proelium through the Battle Pass, through Daily Login rewards, or by buying it directly from the store.
[*] Character upgrades include a new skin with updated geo, a unique emote, and jetpack effects.
[*] Weapon skin upgrades include custom tracer effects, death effects, and reactive effects.
[*] For example, the [b]Deadly Harvest Jackhammer[/b] is a Mythic level weapon skin that comes with three color variants–Rust Bucket, Herbicide, and Lawn Ninja–as well as unique visual effects. 
[/list]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45110560/2fce67c469015825f3f3e35398bc187ad8164c48.jpg[/img]

[h2]“HUNT THE DEVS” IS BACK[/h2]
[list]
[*] For those who didn’t get a chance to participate in our “Hunt the Devs” event during the Open Alpha, we’re bringing it back! 
[*] This is another chance to earn an exclusive skin without paying a dime. 
[*] How it works: during any match, kill a 1047 Games dev wearing the special flaming disco ball skin, and you’ll receive the corresponding “Dev Killer” skin for the faction they’re playing. Kill devs playing Aeros, Sabrask, and Meridian and you’ll collect all 3.
[*] We’ll have some specific times where we’ll invite the community to play in a two-hour Hunt the Devs window when a bunch of 1047 Games devs are playing, too, but the event itself will be ongoing for all of Beta. Check back on our [url=https://discord.com/invite/splitgate]Discord[/url] during the Open Beta for more info.
[/list]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45110560/2c05463304143a3c58c386bb6fc81a1e04ef8ec2.jpg[/img]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45110560/23606f8171700be5b3713f50f97f54a3bbe9d47b.jpg[/img]

[h2]MORE WAYS TO PLAY[/h2]
[list]
[*] We’ve expanded where [i]Splitgate 2[/i] will be available for the Open Beta. In addition to Steam, PS5, and Xbox Series X|S, [i]Splitgate 2[/i] will now also be available on PS4, Xbox One, and Steam Deck (through Proton), as well as on Epic Games and the Microsoft store.
[*] As a reminder, Splitgate 2 has crossplay, so you can play with your friends no matter what platform they’re on.
[*] So, be sure to [url=https://www.splitgate.com/]wishlist Splitgate 2[/url] to stay in the loop for the Open Beta and our upcoming launch! 
[/list]

[h2]FAQ: WILL PROGRESSION BE RESET AFTER BETA?[/h2]
[list]
[*] No, it will not. 
[*] We saw some confusion about this online, so we want to make it clear: player progression will not reset after the Open Beta.
[/list]


[h2]FAQ: WHEN DOES BETA END? WHEN WILL YOU LAUNCH THE FULL GAME???[/h2]
[list]
[*] [url=https://x.com/splitgate/status/1917656703971045447?s=46&t=-9SpIBtuBNms3bZI26AWWA]As we mentioned[/url], the Open Beta will go straight into our launch. 
[*] So, you can start progressing on your Splitgate 2 journey in the Open Beta on May 22nd and then never stop :) 
[/list]


[h2]FAQ: IS THERE MORE?[/h2]
[list]
[*] Yes! Still so much more to come! Like we said above, this still isn’t everything we’re going to have for launch. There’s more – much more – still to come for Splitgate 2. 
[*] For example, we’re going to have weekly rotating playlists of [i]Splitgate 1[/i] community favorite game modes for your portaling pleasure. If there’s a mode from the OG game that you’ve been missing, chances are you’ll be able to play it very soon :) 
[*] We can’t wait to see you in the Open Beta starting on [b]May 22nd at 9am PT[/b] and running live through launch (we’ll announce that date in the near future – stay tuned).
[*] And in the meantime, come say hi on our [url=https://discord.com/invite/splitgate]Discord[/url].
[/list]

notes.title: Play the Splitgate 2 Open Alpha Now
notes.content:
Hey, Splitfam. We’re doing an Open Alpha preview of the work we’ve done on Splitgate 2, available to everyone for four days from Feb. 27 to March 2. Come play with us!

This is your first chance to check out our new Multi-Team Portal Warfare, 8v8v8 battles of colossal proportions set on a massive map. Plus, we’ve got new arena maps, new weapons, new gear, and hundreds of improvements based on community feedback. 

Anyone with [url=https://store.steampowered.com/app/2918300/Splitgate_2/]a Steam account[/url], [url=https://store.playstation.com/en-us/concept/10010012/]a PS5[/url], or [url=https://www.xbox.com/en-US/games/store/splitgate-2/9pf5q1b0fhsl]an Xbox Series X|S[/url] can register and play—for free, as always. Read on for more details about what will be included in the Open Alpha.  
[previewyoutube=iCPoXdZYz3k;full][/previewyoutube]

[h2]MULTI-TEAM PORTAL WARFARE ON A MASSIVE NEW MAP[/h2]
[list]
[*]Multi-Team Portal Warfare is an all new 8v8v8 experience.
[*]Game modes include Multi-Team Hotzone, Multi-Team Domination, and Multi-Team Deathmatch.
[*]To fit our biggest modes yet, we had to make our biggest map yet: Glacier. It’s 20 times bigger than any of our arena maps.
[*]For the lore wolves out there, you might notice that the skybox doesn’t quite look like anything in our solar system—be on the lookout for other clues about what’s to come.
[/list]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45110560/454dfbe6b60d3f34865d2d714990ccc7bcdf188e.jpg[/img]

[h2]NEW ARENA MODE: SPLITBALL[/h2]
[list]
[*]Splitball is one of two new arena modes we’re debuting in this Open Alpha, joining our other core modes, Hotzone and Team Deathmatch. 
[*]Splitball is a twist on classic arena modes like Capture the Flag and Oddball. 
[*]To win, you play offense and defense at the same time, scrambling to capture and return Splitballs that spawn in neutral locations back to your base, while trying to steal Splitballs from the enemy base—and preventing them from stealing yours.
[*]For OG Splitgate players, take note: this mode is completely different from the Splitball in the first Splitgate. Same name, but a completely reimagined mode to be sportier and better than ever. 
[/list]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45110560/b85de4db6b17e052e3423c8390333178c6b40731.jpg[/img]

[h2]NEW ARENA MODE: FIRECRACKER[/h2]
[list]
[*]Firecracker is our other new arena mode. As we were developing this mode internally, the working title was simply “Assault.” 
[*]Firecracker was inspired by Call of Duty’s Search and Destroy, but with the addition of respawns and other changes. The end result combines the thrilling strategy of a round-based, Attack/Defense shooter with Splitgate style.
[*]Teams take turns attempting to successfully plant and defend the Firecracker, resulting in an explosion of fireworks. Heads up: if you make it to a final tiebreaker round, both teams are on offense and defense at the same time.
[*]In our lore, this mode has its origin as a military training exercise for the Sabrask faction. 
[/list]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45110560/f31d66afef165609c887b597443e28aa0cc5a1b5.jpg[/img]

[h2]MORE NEW WEAPONS[/h2]
[list]
[*]Our first Closed Alpha had four weapons per faction; this upcoming Open Alpha will have eight weapons per faction (five primary, three secondary) for a total of twenty-four weapons to experiment with in your loadouts. 
[*]Check out new guns like the Sabrask Goliath revolver, the Meridian Phasma SMG, the Aeros Blitz shotgun, and more.
[*]We’ve also added two additional power weapons since the Closed Alpha, like the triumphant return of our BFB.
[/list]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45110560/d5ac3b33f1f568186ee5fe77312a4c19d0ea4d89.jpg[/img]

[h2]MORE NEW EQUIPMENT[/h2]
[list]
[*]There’s also now nine different pieces of equipment to deepen the strategic possibilities at hand, three per faction. 
[*]Be sure to check out the Sabrask Sandstorm grenade (like a smoke grenade, but sandier), the Meridian Regen Cloud (an explosion of health for you and your teammates), and the Aeros Porta-Portal (a deploy-anywhere temporary portal, freeing you from the need to place portals on the arena’s pre-set walls).
[/list]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45110560/3872bf26a14c24760c5fc85e7a274d0e733d8bf3.jpg[/img]

[h2]LISTENING TO THE COMMUNITY[/h2]
[list]
[*]Thanks to all of the community feedback we’ve gotten from playtests and gameplay we’ve shared online, we’ve made a litany of improvements to every single aspect of the game.
[*]We heard that you wanted more action, so we made respawns shorter and rounds longer. 
[*]We also heard that you wanted more portaling options, so we added more portal walls to our existing maps, and added new portal opportunities like a Launch Portal, a combination of a portal wall and a launch pad that will send you flying. 
[*]To learn more about how seriously we take community feedback, you can read more about the changes in this [url=https://x.com/Splitgate/status/1831063991055265945]message[/url] from Ian Proulx, cofounder and CEO of 1047 Games, or watch this Dev Talk from Ian and our other co-founder, Nicholas Bagamian.
[/list]
[previewyoutube=MvYFySoOz6k;full][/previewyoutube]

[h2]TWITCH DROPS ENABLED[/h2]
[list]
[*]Watch Splitgate 2 streams on Twitch during the Open Alpha to earn the Haunt Cadence, a weapon skin for the Aeros carbine.
[*]For more info on how Twitch drops work, check out this [url=https://www.splitgate.com/news/twitch-drops]FAQ[/url].
[/list]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45110560/91cfc283f8e8d47d81066acd2c37860ad78a6565.png[/img]

[h2]1047 GIFTED SUBS[/h2]
[list]
[*]The Splitgate 2 community team will be gifting 1047 Twitch subs throughout the Open Alpha weekend.
[*]Be on the lookout for our team as they hop into Splitgate 2 Twitch streams and give out subs!
[/list]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45110560/7ea4c656a19c766e112290bee85a7e72be9141b8.png[/img]

[h2]HUNT THE DEVS, EARN REWARDS[/h2]
[list]
[*]Want to be the first to earn a Dev Killer skin? All you have to do is kill one of our devs in a match anytime during the Open Alpha. 
[*]You can tell when you encounter a 1047 developer because their head will be a disco ball, our company logo. 
[*]You’ll earn a Dev Killer skin, decked out in skulls representing your dev conquest.
[*]There’s three different skins to earn, one for each faction. You earn the same skin as the dev you kill. So, kill a dev playing as Sabrask with a disco ball head, you’ll earn the Sabrask Dev Killer skin (regardless of what faction you were playing as). 
[/list]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45110560/ffa7990db53812a09ac37a02f55819d22bdb4e10.png[/img]

[h2]OPEN ALPHA COMMUNITY CHALLENGE[/h2]
[list]
[*]Share your Splitgate 2 clips with us on social and tag us for a chance to have your content featured on our channels.
[*]We’re also hosting two Community Challenges during the Open Alpha.
[*]Submit your best Porta-Portal plays or Hunt the Devs kill reels in our [url=http://discord.gg/splitgate]Discord[/url] and the most upvoted clips will win Steam gift cards.
[/list]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45110560/834b17f2041605bf3b0bbeee4ea7746381df3f98.png[/img]

[h2]READY TO PLAY?[/h2]
[list]
[*]Thanks for reading, Splitfam. Remember, even with all of these new updates and features, this is just the beginning. The Open Alpha represents less than half of all of the new content we’re going to have in the full version at launch.
[*]Again, you can find the Open Alpha on Steam, PS5 and Xbox Series X|S. No need to sign up, just portal into the action on your gaming system of choice Feb 27 to March 2.
[*]And to keep in the loop about our full launch later this year, be the first to know by staying in touch with us on our [url=http://discord.gg/splitgate]Discord[/url] or signing up for our newsletter on [url=https://cdn.gsght.com/c/4bcjly]splitgate.com[/url].

Choose your faction, team up and earn glory in the Splitgate 2 Alpha, beginning August 21 and continuing through August 25.

[h3]When is Alpha happening and how long will it last?[/h3]
The initial Alpha will be available from approximately 9am Pacific (noon Eastern, 5pm BST, 6pm CEST) on August 21, 2024 until 8pm Pacific (11pm Eastern, 4am BST, 5am CEST, both August 26) on August 25, 2024. To figure out what time that is in your part of the world, we recommend checking out [url=https://www.everytimezone.com/]Everytimezone.com[/url].

[h3]Am I guaranteed to be able to play in Alpha for Splitgate 2?[/h3]
We can’t guarantee access and are not able to announce how many players will be allowed in. We’ll be allowing more people in throughout the Alpha and certainly hope you get in!

[h3]After I’ve applied to Alpha, do I have to re-apply in future?[/h3]
No you don’t. Once you’ve applied for access to Alpha, you’re on the list to be granted access for any future Alphas. In addition, once you’re granted access, it’s for all Alphas.

[h3]I’m a content creator, can I stream and/or make content about Splitgate 2?[/h3]
Absolutely. There are no restrictions on streaming or capturing gameplay during Alpha. Make sure that when you post, you tag @Splitgate on our socials, or use the hashtag #Splitgate2 so we can see it. Also you might consider applying to our [url=https://mvp.splitgate.com/]Splitgate MVP Program[/url].

Read the rest of the FAQ at [url=https://www.splitgate.com/]Splitgate.com[/url].
